ElementId.description: A sketch element's ID: 8 characters of Crockford's base32 in lower case (digits and letters but i, l, o, and u), unique within its sketch.

FeatureId.description: A feature's ID: 8 characters of Crockford's base32 in lower case (digits and letters but i, l, o, and u).

request.description: `sketch_unjoin`'s request: pull one curve's use of a shared point apart.

curve.description:
The curve to detach, by ID: it gets a new point at the same coordinates, with none
of the point's constraints but every one of its own.

ids.description:
The new point's ID, a list of one fresh random 8-character ID; or null for the core
to make it.

point.description:
The point two or more curves share, by ID. The curves that stay keep it, and every
constraint on it.

revision.description:
The session's revision the edit was made against: an edit against another is
refused as a `conflict`.

session.description: The session's ID, as `open` gave it.

sketch.description: The sketch, by its feature's ID.

request.title: SketchUnjoinRequest

CommitResult.description:
What a commit did: `commit`'s result, and the commit an edit made outside a transaction
holds (each such edit is saved as its own transaction).

path.description: The document's path, as `open` was given it.

problems.description:
What the commit couldn't fix, the first 100: failed features, and the drift of
features no edit reached, whose fingerprints it leaves as stored (only `format`
accepts drift).

problems_total.description: How many problems there are, listed or not.

refingerprinted.description:
The features the edits reached whose fingerprints were written anew, in timeline
order.

resolved.description: The sketches the edits reached whose solves were written anew, in timeline order.

written.description:
Whether the file was written: false when the document is the one the transaction
began with.

ElementId.description: A sketch element's ID: 8 characters of Crockford's base32 in lower case (digits and letters but i, l, o, and u), unique within its sketch.

Error.description:
Why a command was refused, or a problem it found, in Silico's error contract: a code, a
message, and, where they apply, the feature, the elements at fault (the first of them, and
how many in all), the request's field at fault, the cause, what to do, and the names that
might have been meant. Every field is always present: null, or empty, where it doesn't
apply.

candidates.description: What might have been meant, such as the names nearest one that found nothing.

cause.description: What lay under it, such as the kernel's own failure, if known.

code.description: What kind of error it is: one of Silico's error codes, such as `invalid_input`.

elements.description: The elements at fault, by name: the first of them, if there are many.

elements_total.description: How many elements are at fault, listed or not.

feature.description: The ID of the feature at fault, if one is.

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence.

parameter.description: The field at fault, as a dotted path (`position.2`), if one is.

suggestion.description: What to do about it, if Silico can say.

FeatureId.description: A feature's ID: 8 characters of Crockford's base32 in lower case (digits and letters but i, l, o, and u).

added.description: The new point, the detached curve's.

changed.description: Whether the document changed: always, for an unjoin it makes.

commit.description: Outside a transaction, the commit that saved the edit; null inside one.

modified.description:
The members changed in place (the detached curve; a `tangent_on` of it at the point,
moved to the new point), by kind, then by ID.

removed.description:
The members removed (a `tangent_at` of the detached curve at the point), by kind,
then by ID.

sketch.description: The sketch, as the request named it.
